data.name: Kaironia
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Kaironia 

    Kaironia is a 2D idle and incremental RPG built from the ground up for fans of classic, retro MMORPGs. Relive the nostalgic days of endless skilling, deep progression, and hunting for the perfect loot drop; all distilled into a streamlined, friction-free idle experience.

Master Classic Skills 

    Cut down towering trees, mine precious ores, fish the local waters, and forage for rare herbs. Then, process your hard-earned materials through skills like Smithing to forge powerful gear. With mathematical pacing designed for the long haul, reaching level 99 in any skill is a true badge of honor.

Engaging Combat & Loot

    Equip your best Melee, Ranged, or Magic gear and take on fearsome monsters and bosses. Farm for rare drops, fill your bank with wealth, and optimize your loadout to become a legendary hero.

Respects Your Time: The Time Bank

    Your adventure doesn't stop when you close the game. Kaironia features a robust offline progression system that banks your away time, down to the second. Log back in and use your accumulated Time Bank to fast-forward through actions, allowing you to play at your own pace without needing to leave your PC running overnight.

A Living, Shared World

    Don't want to idle alone? Kaironia features optional self-hosted multiplayer where you can show off your hard-earned gear, trade resources, or just stand around a bank complaining about the grind with your friends.

Key Features:

  • Retro RPG Nostalgia: A classic aesthetic, grid-based world, and a gameplay loop that captures the golden age of online RPGs.

  • Deep Skilling System: Gather resources across multiple disciplines and process them into valuable goods and upgrades.

  • Friction-Free Gameplay: We've eliminated the tedious micromanagement of hyper-specific "skilling outfits." Gear up for combat with your best stats and gather freely without constant inventory swapping.

  • True Offline Progression: Accumulate 1:1 progress time while offline and use it to accelerate your actions when you return.

  • Dynamic Paperdoll System: See every piece of armor and weapon you equip visually represented on your character.

  • A Balanced Grind: A meticulously balanced progression curve designed to offer hundreds of hours of satisfying gameplay.

  • Classic Game Modes: Choose how you play. Go standard drifter, challenge yourself with 'Lone Drifter' (no trading), or risk it all in 'Mortal Mode' (Hardcore permadeath). Play on legacy mode with active clicking, no item stacking, and loot drop on death for a punishing MMO-like experience, or set the XP and loot to 3x for an easy, casual experience. Play the game the way you enjoy!

  • The Grand Codex: A completionist's dream. Track every item you've ever discovered, master the Bestiary by studying monster drops, and fill out your massive collection log.

  • Quests & NPCs: Engage with a full dialogue and questing system. Talk to the locals, solve their problems, and uncover the secrets of the world.

Add Kaironia to your Wishlist today and prepare to lose yourself in the ultimate retro idle experience!

data.short_description: Relive the golden age of MMOs in this friction-free 2D idle RPG. Chop trees, forge armor, and slay monsters to reach level 99. Play solo or hang out with friends in multiplayer and utilize the offline Time Bank to fast-forward the grind. Pure nostalgia, built to respect your time.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core processor, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent, with OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible or standard onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: An internet connection is required for online multiplayer features
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
